note: Adapted from the descriptions of Holmgren and Holmgren (1917) and Roonwal and Sen-Sarma (1960) as reported by Chhotani (1997); the original is in English; soldier, worker and alate are all treated, the worker being dimorphic; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted; the section on venational variation is not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier frontal projection weak or absent, frons steeply sloping anteriorly; mandibles long and sword-shaped, nearly as long as the head, each with a distinct medially placed tooth. Alate pronotum nearly trapezoidal, posterior margin with a strong median notch. Worker dimorphic.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale straw yellow; antennae and body creamy white; mandibles brown, straw yellow at the base. Head and body hairy. Body length 3.5–4.6 mm. Head oval, rather thick, sides slightly convex; head length to mandibular base 1.0–1.05 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.85 mm, height 0.60–0.65 mm. Frontal projection weak or absent; frons steeply sloping anteriorly. Fontanelle circular and conspicuous, situated at the beginning of the frontal slope; fontanelle gland large and long, distance from the occiput to the fontanelle 0.85 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than or nearly equal to segment 2, segment 4 nearly equal to or shorter than segment 3. Mandibles long, sword-shaped, apex slightly incurved; length nearly equal to the head length (1.0–1.05 mm), ratio of left mandible length to head length 1.0–1.07; outer margin incurved below the tooth; each mandible with a sharp and distinct medially placed tooth (ratio of left mandibular tooth distance to mandible length 0.52–0.57). Gula swollen in lateral view; length 0.55 mm, maximum width 0.25–0.30 mm, minimum waist width 0.15–0.20 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a weak notch, posterior margin without a notch; length 0.30 mm, width 0.50–0.55 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow; antennae and body creamy white. Head and body densely hairy. Body length about 4.0 mm. Head subsquare; head length to mandibular base 0.75 mm, width 0.85 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus convex and hairy. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25 mm, width 0.55 mm. Minor worker: identical to the major worker except in its smaller size; body length about 3.0 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.65 mm, head width 0.75 mm, pronotum length 0.25 mm, width 0.50 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to pale brown; postclypeus straw yellow; thorax slightly paler than the head; antennae, legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head and body densely hairy. Body length with wings 8.0–9.2 mm, without wings 5.5–6.20 mm. Head capsule roundly oval, slightly flattened; head length to mandibular base 0.65–0.80 mm, width including eyes 0.83–0.90 mm. Fontanelle plate slightly elongate, whitish, situated medially. Compound eyes subcircular, diameter 0.20–0.23 mm, not very prominent. Ocelli oval, maximum diameter 0.075–0.10 mm; distance from the compound eye 0.05–0.062 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus convex, length about equal to half the width. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal; length 0.48–0.53 mm, width 0.73–0.80 mm; anterior margin nearly straight or slightly convex, with a very weak notch; posterior margin straight, with a strong median notch. Wings transparent and colourless, membrane densely covered with micrasters and sparsely hairy; fore wing length 6.4–7.2 mm, hind wing length 5.8–6.7 mm.
